description: LangChain create_agent with one tool and two model turns, traced by OpenInference.
notes: Only LangChainInstrumentor is enabled. OpenInference records message content by default, and this scenario sets no content-capture environment variable. The agent is langchain.agents.create_agent, the LangChain 1.x ReAct-style graph. create_react_agent is still in langgraph.prebuilt. ChatOpenAI is pointed at the mock. The capture keeps seven spans: the graph chain, a model chain, the LLM, a tools chain, the tool, then the model chain and LLM again. Token counts are copied. The second LLM span's prompt is 131 and prompt_details.cache_read is 64, and the zero detail counts are written. llm.finish_reason is tool_calls, then stop, on the span only. The tool output is a serialized tool message. Run, message, and checkpoint ids are pinned to a counter so a recapture stays stable.
